messages:
nina_sales: Heads-up: BigCorp's procurement sent a vendor risk checklist and flagged IAM as a gating item. They asked for SSO metadata, MFA enforcement statements, RBAC role dump, and a short explanation of service-account separation. Need an initial package by EOD.

chloe_security: I can draft the narrative for the SIG/CAIQ questions and include snippets from our policy. Do we want to hand them the raw SAML metadata or a sanitized excerpt?

nina_sales: They asked for SP metadata + confirmation we can also supply IdP endpoints if needed. Also they'd like screenshots proving MFA challenges for admin flows.

devin_engineer: I can export the SP metadata from the control plane. Command I used last time: 
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $PLATFORM_ADMIN" \ 
  "https://console.redwood.ai/sso/metadata/sp" -o redwood-sp-metadata.xml
```
I'll include cert thumbprints and entityID notes in README.

ryan_ops: For MFA evidence we'll pull Okta events and a sample login replay. Okta export cmd: 
```bash
okta logs query 'eventType eq "user.session.start" and outcome.result eq "SUCCESS" and factorsUsed.exists()' --since 90d > okta-mfa-sample.json
```
I'll scrub user emails and session ids before sharing.

chloe_security: Policy excerpt we will include: 
```yaml
iam_policies:
  enforce_mfa_for_admins: true
  allowed_service_account_scopes:
    - inference_read
    - inference_infer
  human_accounts_require_console_mfa: true
```
Plus a short paragraph explaining enforcement via conditional access.

nina_sales: Also they asked whether we enforce RBAC least privilege for internal tools and if custom roles exist.

devin_engineer: Roles export available from admin UI; I'll regenerate CSV: roles-export-2026-03-21.csv. It lists role_id, name, permissions, default_scope.

ryan_ops: We'll add a small annex describing service accounts: scoped tokens, no console login, rotate keys every 30 days via automated job.

snyk-bot: Reminder: dependency scan on branch iam-docs found no critical alerts.

nina_sales: Ok team, can we confirm delivery timeline? I need to inform procurement.

chloe_security: I'll have the write-up + policy excerpts by 14:30 PT.

devin_engineer: SP metadata + README by 15:30 PT.

ryan_ops: Sanitized Okta sample + login screenshot by 16:30 PT.

nina_sales: Great. Upload to the secure presigned link and let me know when done.

ryan_ops: Uploaded prelim bundle: https://s3.redwood.internal/presigned/SALES-9332/iam-package-prelim.zip

chloe_security: Uploaded security_summary.pdf and policy_excerpts.yaml

devin_engineer: Uploaded redwood-sp-metadata.xml and metadata-readme.txt

nina_sales: Sending initial package to BigCorp now. Message: \"Attached: SP metadata, MFA evidence (sanitized), RBAC export, and our service-account separation note. Happy to provide more detail under NDA if needed.\"

chloe_security: If they request raw logs we'll require an approved DPA/NDA and security will coordinate redaction.

nina_sales: BigCorp replied: 'Can you confirm that MFA is enforced for all users with write/admin perms and provide the admin role definition?'\
ryan_ops: Reply: MFA enforcement policy applies to roles with manage_* and admin_* permissions. See roles-export CSV row for role 'platform_admin' and attached policy excerpt. Service accounts are distinct and cannot request interactive sessions.

nina_sales: Thanks team, marking blocker cleared in Salesforce.

snyk-bot: Scan complete. No action required.
